title: Google Maps Timeline alternative | Dayline
description: Google Maps Timeline now lives only on your phone. Dayline is a free, automatic travel log that draws each day as a line and keeps it on your device.
h1: Looking for a Google Maps Timeline alternative?
lede: Google Maps Timeline has changed how it keeps your history. If you want another automatic record of where you went each day, here is what changed, what Dayline does, and what to know before you switch.
changed_title: What changed with Google Maps Timeline
changed: Google Maps now saves your Timeline on each signed-in phone instead of in your Google account online. Timeline is no longer available in Maps on a computer, and a copy is kept on Google's servers only if you turn on encrypted backup.

Google asked people to choose what to keep before the change reached their account, and history that was not kept could be deleted. Many people are now looking for another app that keeps a record of their days.
glance_rows: On your phone, with optional encrypted backup
glance_note: Based on Google Maps Help and Dayline's own description.
how_lede: Dayline is an automatic travel log for iOS and Android, made by Zaco Labs.
limits: Dayline records from the day you install it.
To draw your path while the app is closed, location access has to be set to "Always" ("Allow all the time" on Android).
Dayline is free and shows one ad below the tab bar.
source_label: Google Maps Help: Manage your Google Maps Timeline
